checks.label: Empty input
checks.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

+ [
+   [
+     ''
+   ]
+ ]
- []

checks.label: CRLF records and trailing separator
checks.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
    [
      'a',
+     'b\r'
-     'b'
    ],
    [
      'c',
+     'd\r'
-     'd'
    ],
+   [
+     ''
+   ]
  ]

checks.label: Quoted comma
checks.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
    [
+     '"hello',
+     ' world"',
-     'hello, world',
      'x'
    ]
  ]

checks.label: Escaped double quotes
checks.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
    [
+     '"say ""hi"""',
-     'say "hi"',
      'y'
    ]
  ]

checks.label: Quoted LF newline
checks.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
    [
+     '"line1'
+   ],
+   [
+     'line2"',
-     'line1\nline2',
      'z'
    ]
  ]

checks.label: No extra row after trailing newline

Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
    [
      'a',
      'b'
    ],
+   [
+     ''
+   ]
  ]
